newsitem.title: USA: Triathlon plans radio station buys.
newsitem.headline: Triathlon plans radio station buys.

text.p: Triathlon Broadcasting Co said Thursday it had agreed to acquire radio stations KGOR-FM and KFAB-AM, in Omaha, Neb. from American Radio Systems Corp for $39 million.
Triathlon also will acquire the exclusive Muzak franchise for the Omaha and Lincoln, Nebraska markets. It currently owns and operates radio stations KTNP-FM and KXKT-FM in Omaha.

"Our existing two Omaha stations are posting impressive results, and a four station cluster will provide opportunity for even greater economies and effective ad selling," Norman Feurer, chief executive officer, said.
